from collections import Counter
def feats(d):
    c=Counter(x for r in d for x in r); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ranked=[x for x,_ in c.most_common()]; w=ranked[1] if len(ranked)>1 else None
    n=len(d)
    out={}
    for col in range(10):
        pos=[(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if d[i][j]==col]
        if not pos: continue
        iso=all((i+di,j+dj) not in pos for i,j in pos for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)))
        interior=all(0<i<n-1 and 0<j<n-1 for i,j in pos)
        touchw=any(d[i+di][j+dj]==w for i,j in pos for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=i+di<n and 0<=j+dj<n)
        touchb=any(d[i+di][j+dj]==bg for i,j in pos for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=i+di<n and 0<=j+dj<n)
        border=any(i in(0,n-1) or j in(0,n-1) for i,j in pos)
        out[col]=(c[col],iso,interior,touchw,touchb,border)
    return out,bg,w
for k,(d,o) in dems.items():
    f,bg,w=feats(d)
    M={(i,j) for i in range(3) for j in range(3) if o[i][j]==8}
    print('demo',k,'bg',bg,'wall',w)
    for col in sorted(f):
        cnt,iso,inte,tw,tb,bd=f[col]
        cell=(col//3,col%3)
        mark=cell in M
        print(f'  c{col} cnt{cnt} iso{iso} int{inte} tw{tw} tb{tb} bord{bd} marked{mark}')

import itertools
def colorfeats(d, marked):
    c=Counter(x for r in d for x in r)
    ranked=[x for x,_ in c.most_common()]
    bg=ranked[0]; wall=ranked[1] if len(ranked)>1 else bg
    n=7
    rows={}
    for col in range(10):
        pos=[(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if d[i][j]==col]
        if not pos and col not in marked: continue
        if not pos: pos=[]
        def nb(i,j):
            return [d[i+di][j+dj] for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=i+di<n and 0<=j+dj<n]
        f={}
        f['cnt']=c[col]
        f['present']=bool(pos)
        f['iso']=all(d[i][j] not in nb(i,j) for i,j in pos) if pos else None
        f['allint']=all(0<i<n-1 and 0<j<n-1 for i,j in pos) if pos else None
        f['someint']=any(0<i<n-1 and 0<j<n-1 for i,j in pos)
        f['adjwall_all']=all(wall in nb(i,j) for i,j in pos) if pos else None
        f['adjwall_some']=any(wall in nb(i,j) for i,j in pos)
        f['adjbg_all']=all(bg in nb(i,j) for i,j in pos) if pos else None
        f['adjbg_some']=any(bg in nb(i,j) for i,j in pos)
        f['samecol']=len({j for i,j in pos})==1 if pos else None
        f['samerow']=len({i for i,j in pos})==1 if pos else None
        f['diag_distinct']=len({(i%3,j%3) for i,j in pos})==len(pos) if pos else None
        md=max((abs(a-b)+abs(e-f2) for (a,e),(b,f2) in itertools.combinations(pos,2)), default=-1)
        f['maxpair']=md
        f['marked']=((col//3,col%3) in marked)
        rows[col]=f
    return rows
allrows={}
for k,(d,o) in sorted(dems.items()):

for k,rows in sorted(allrows.items()):

    for col,f in sorted(rows.items()):
        if col in (0,) : pass
        print(' c%d'%col, {a:b for a,b in f.items()})

def cells(d,col):
    return [(i,j) for i in range(7) for j in range(7) if d[i][j]==col]
# check per-color residue profiles
for k,(d,o) in sorted(dems.items()):
    mk=set(3*i+j for i,j in Mk[k])
    print('demo',k,'marked',sorted(mk))
    for col in range(10):
        ps=cells(d,col)
        if not ps or col in (Counter(x for r in d for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0],): continue
        s=[(i+j)%3 for i,j in ps]; t=[(i-j)%3 for i,j in ps]
        print(f'  c{col} marked={col in mk} sums={s} diffs={t} modpos={[(i%3,j%3) for i,j in ps]}')

def proj_search():
    maps={}
    for name,f in [
        ('id',lambda r,c:(r%3,c%3)),
        ('rv',lambda r,c:((2-r)%3,c%3)),
        ('rh',lambda r,c:(r%3,(2-c)%3)),
        ('rhv',lambda r,c:((2-r)%3,(2-c)%3)),
        ('tr',lambda r,c:(c%3,r%3)),
        ('trv',lambda r,c:(c%3,(2-r)%3)),
        ('trh',lambda r,c:((2-c)%3,r%3)),
        ('trhv',lambda r,c:((2-c)%3,(2-r)%3)),
        ('sum',lambda r,c:((r+c)%3,0)),
        ('dif',lambda r,c:((r-c)%3,0)),
        ('row',lambda r,c:(r%3,0)),
        ('col',lambda r,c:(c%3,0)),
        ('sum2',lambda r,c:((r+c)%3,(r-c)%3)),
        ('halves',lambda r,c:(min(r%3,2-r%3),min(c%3,2-c%3))),
    ]: maps[name]=f
    sels={
      'rare': lambda v,bg,w: v not in (bg,w) and v<=7,
      'rare89': lambda v,bg,w: v not in (bg,w) and v>=8,
      'allrare': lambda v,bg,w: v not in (bg,w),
      'wall': lambda v,bg,w: v==w,
      'bg': lambda v,bg,w: v==bg,
      'nonbg': lambda v,bg,w: v!=bg,
      'rare_wall': lambda v,bg,w: v==w or (v not in (bg,w) and v<=7),
    }
    hits=[]
    for k,(dd,oo) in sorted(dems.items()):
        cnts=Counter(x for r in dd for x in r); bg=cnts.most_common(1)[0][0]
        w=cnts.most_common(2)[1][0]
        act={ (i,j) for i in range(3) for j in range(3) if oo[i][j]==8 }
        for sn,sf in sels.items():
            pts=[(i,j) for i in range(7) for j in range(7) if sf(dd[i][j],bg,w)]
            for mn,mf in maps.items():
                pred={mf(r,c) for r,c in pts}
                if pred==act: hits.append((k,sn,mn))
    return hits
h=proj_search(); print(h)
